gui.respectcraft.holo.settings.title: Display
gui.respectcraft.holo.settings.scale.des: Scales the whole holographic menu. Applied when you release the slider.
gui.respectcraft.holo.settings.opacity.d: Opacity of the panel glass. Text always stays fully opaque.

Darker, opaque panels and brighter text; no scan lines.
Desaturates and tints the world behind the menu.

Strength of the opening and closing animation. 0% = simple fade. Reduced motion always uses a fade.
